title: Transaction classification and business-purpose exclusions
applicability: Every intake; determine purpose, borrower type, occupancy, collateral, lien and broker/creditor role separately for each law.
requirement: Document the actual purpose and applicable exceptions. A DSCR or bank-statement label is not itself a TILA exemption; ECOA, licensing and other laws can still apply.
platformGap: Unverified: no reviewed cross-law applicability decision engine established by this research.
evidence: Reviewer-approved classification, supporting facts, applicable rule version and reassessment after material changes.

title: TRID application and disclosure deadlines
applicability: Covered closed-end consumer real-property or cooperative-unit loans; distinct rules for excluded products and exceptions.
requirement: Track regulatory application receipt, LE issuance, intent to proceed, fee restrictions, changed circumstances, CD receipt and waiting periods. Assign broker/lender delivery responsibilities.
platformGap: Partial: the closing workbench tracks manual disclosure status and date; this is not evidence of deadline, delivery or tolerance compliance.
evidence: Six-item receipt timestamps, versioned package and fees, delivery/receipt evidence, business-day calendar, lender responsibility and exception approvals.

title: Rescission and funding release
applicability: Certain consumer transactions secured by a principal dwelling; purchase-money and other exceptions require classification.
requirement: Identify every entitled consumer, deliver required notices and material disclosures, calculate the applicable rescission period and enforce release restrictions.
platformGap: Unverified: recording closing/funding dates does not establish rescission eligibility or lawful release.
evidence: Each recipient's notice version and receipt, consummation date, expiry calculation and legally valid waiver evidence where allowed.

title: HOEPA high-cost mortgage screening
applicability: Covered consumer mortgages subject to high-cost thresholds and exclusions.
requirement: Evaluate APR, points/fees and prepayment triggers against effective-date thresholds; route covered loans for special disclosures, counseling and prohibited-term review.
platformGap: Unverified: pricing samples do not demonstrate a validated high-cost calculation service.
evidence: Threshold version, APOR snapshot, included/excluded fee audit, calculation inputs, counseling and reviewed disclosure package.

title: Higher-priced loans, escrow and appraisal
applicability: Covered higher-priced mortgage loans; lien, transaction and creditor exemptions affect obligations.
requirement: Classify HPML independently from HOEPA; evaluate escrow and appraisal obligations and exceptions.
platformGap: Unverified: no legal-grade HPML applicability and threshold evidence established.
evidence: APOR/date and APR basis, lien and creditor facts, appraisal/escrow decisions and any exception rationale.

title: Ability to repay and qualified mortgage evidence
applicability: Covered dwelling-secured consumer loans; lender is ordinarily the creditor, with product-specific exclusions.
requirement: Preserve verified underwriting facts and lender ATR/QM determination; support current product and points/fees rules without equating AUS findings to compliance.
platformGap: Partial: mock DU/LPA results are fictional findings, not ATR/QM determinations.
evidence: Verified income/assets/debts, underwriting versions, lender determination, product criteria and approval provenance.

title: Loan-originator compensation, steering and identification
applicability: Covered loan originators and organizations in dwelling-secured credit; provisions differ by transaction.
requirement: Validate compensation and anti-steering restrictions, originator qualifications and required identifiers; prevent impermissible compensation based on loan terms.
platformGap: Unverified: brokerage reporting and quote comparison alone do not validate compensation or steering.
evidence: Effective compensation agreement, payer/amount ledger, offered options and reasons, originator identifiers and qualification review.

title: RESPA referrals and affiliated arrangements
applicability: Settlement services involving federally related mortgage loans, subject to RESPA coverage/exceptions.
requirement: Prevent prohibited referral payments and unearned fee splits; separately evaluate affiliated-business disclosures and exception conditions under section 1024.15.
platformGap: Partial: realtor referrals and campaign attribution exist; no validated referral-compensation compliance control established.
evidence: Services actually performed, contracts, payment basis, affiliated ownership, disclosure delivery and no-required-use review.

title: ECOA notices and application outcomes
applicability: Consumer and business credit; creditor participation and business-credit exceptions determine duties.
requirement: Classify completed/incomplete applications and actions; assign timely notification and accurate adverse-action reasons. Withdrawal cannot substitute for a denial.
platformGap: Partial: disposition/hold workflows exist; no verified Reg B notice clock and artifact workflow established.
evidence: Application completeness timeline, action/reason codes, responsible creditor, notice version/delivery and exception basis.

title: Fair lending and protected information
applicability: ECOA credit activities and separately Fair Housing Act residential real-estate-related transactions.
requirement: Prevent unlawful discriminatory treatment and prohibited information use; review current 2026 Reg B amendments and independent FHA/state protections.
platformGap: Unverified: routing, campaign segmentation and pricing require a fair-lending review; no certification is established.
evidence: Approved decision/routing criteria, protected-data access controls, versioned templates, complaint investigation and outcome review.

title: Appraisal copies and notices
applicability: Applications for credit secured by a first lien on a dwelling, including relevant business credit.
requirement: Provide required appraisal-right notice and copies of appraisals/valuations on the prescribed schedule; track valid timing waivers separately.
platformGap: Unverified: document requests/uploads do not establish timely valuation delivery.
evidence: Application date, notice receipt, valuation completion/delivery, recipient list and waiver provenance.

title: HMDA applicability and reporting
applicability: Institutions and transactions meeting Regulation C coverage; broker-only activity does not automatically create filing duties.
requirement: Determine annual institutional coverage, who made the credit decision and transaction reporting responsibility; validate reportable data and privacy rules.
platformGap: Partial: Mortgage Call Report preparation is not HMDA LAR reporting; full HMDA validation is unverified.
evidence: Annual coverage decision, reporting entity, ULI/data lineage, edit results, filing acknowledgement and retained submission.

title: FCRA credit reports and notices
applicability: Obtaining/using consumer reports, including individual reports in some business-purpose transactions.
requirement: Establish permissible purpose before access; provide applicable FCRA adverse-action, credit-score and risk-based-pricing notices or valid exceptions.
platformGap: Partial: the credit workbench records demo authorization; live permissible-purpose and statutory notice fulfillment are unverified.
evidence: Permissible-purpose determination, borrower identity, provider order and report, score factors, responsible notice issuer and delivery.

title: Mortgage trigger-lead restrictions
applicability: Mortgage inquiry-triggered prescreened consumer reports; distinct from ordinary first-party/referral leads.
requirement: Apply Public Law 119-36 restrictions and statutory exceptions; require defensible source/authorization or qualifying relationship evidence before using such leads.
platformGap: Unverified: generic CSV import/source labels do not establish lawful trigger-lead provenance.
evidence: Vendor/source classification, acquisition date, statutory exception and authorization/relationship evidence; do not infer consent from import.

title: SAFE Act and state license authority
applicability: Individuals engaging in covered residential mortgage origination; state licenses versus federal registration depend on employer/activity.
requirement: Verify required authority and sponsorship for entity, branch and individual before covered activity; apply state overlays and renewals.
platformGap: Partial: team roles and loan ownership are access controls, not proof of licensing.
evidence: NMLS identifier, regulator/source, state, license type/status, sponsorship, expiry and last verification.

title: GLBA privacy notices and sharing
applicability: Covered financial institutions and consumer/customer nonpublic personal information; exceptions differ from state privacy laws.
requirement: Deliver applicable initial/annual or revised privacy notices and opt-out rights; constrain sharing, redisclosure and reuse to permitted purposes.
platformGap: Partial: tenant/portal scoping exists; notice delivery, sharing inventory and legal exceptions remain unverified.
evidence: Notice version/delivery, relationship type, recipients and sharing purpose, opt-out status and exception basis.

title: GLBA safeguards and incident response
applicability: FTC-covered financial institutions including mortgage brokers, plus service-provider contractual responsibilities; limited small-entity exemptions are not blanket exemptions.
requirement: Maintain a risk-based written security program, qualified oversight, access safeguards, encryption/MFA, testing, vendor oversight and incident response; assess FTC notification events.
platformGap: Partial: access checks/private documents/scanning are foundations, not a verified Safeguards program or operational attestation.
evidence: Risk assessment, MFA/encryption evidence, vendor reviews, incident timeline, testing, board/senior report and notification determination.

title: E-SIGN consent and signed artifacts
applicability: Electronic delivery of legally required consumer written records; other signature/record rules still apply.
requirement: Obtain compliant affirmative electronic consent with disclosures and demonstrated access; support withdrawal/paper options and accessible retained records.
platformGap: Partial: manual Signed status is not consent, signature or completed artifact evidence.
evidence: Consent text/version, access demonstration, recipient identity, document hash, envelope audit, downloadable artifact and withdrawal history.

title: TCPA calling and texting
applicability: Calls/texts according to technology, purpose, number type and consent; apply FCC waivers and state rules separately.
requirement: Resolve consent, DNC and calling-hour eligibility before contact; process revocation; version current waiver/effective-date logic rather than assume every rule is operative.
platformGap: Partial: brokerage opt-outs exist; public intake consent boolean and Eastern-time retry scheduling do not establish channel-specific consent or recipient-local eligibility.
evidence: Exact consent and seller/scope, contact/source, local timezone, scrub result, revocation receipt and suppression propagation.

title: Telemarketing Sales Rule and DNC records
applicability: Covered sellers/telemarketers; broker and vendor coverage/exemptions require individual assessment.
requirement: Apply national/entity-specific DNC restrictions, calling windows, required disclosures and current recordkeeping rules; purchased leads do not bypass them.
platformGap: Partial: call history/callbacks exist; registry subscription/scrub proof and compliant calling eligibility are unverified.
evidence: Seller/campaign/script versions, DNC access and scrub, consent/relationship exception, call metadata, opt-outs and vendor agreement.

title: CAN-SPAM commercial email
applicability: Commercial email, including business-to-business; distinguish transaction/relationship primary purpose.
requirement: Use accurate headers and subjects, required advertising identification/address and working opt-out; honor opt-outs within ten business days and oversee vendors.
platformGap: Partial: drafts/manual copy and opt-outs do not prove live email template or unsubscribe compliance.
evidence: Sent message/template, sender/address, classification, opt-out mechanism receipt and suppression before subsequent sends.

title: AML program and confidential SAR workflow
applicability: Covered nonbank residential mortgage lenders/originators, including covered brokers.
requirement: Maintain AML policies, compliance officer, training and independent testing; evaluate and file required SARs, preserving confidentiality and records.
platformGap: Unverified: ordinary loan activity and borrower/realtor portals are inappropriate for SAR narratives; restricted case handling is not established.
evidence: AML risk/program review, training/testing, restricted detection timeline, filing decision and acknowledgement; separate from general exports.

title: OFAC sanctions review
applicability: US persons and transactions subject to applicable sanctions programs; not merely financial institutions.
requirement: Prevent prohibited dealings and assess ownership/program restrictions, blocking/rejection and reporting where applicable.
platformGap: Unverified: no sanctions-screening disposition and evidence workflow established.
evidence: Screened parties and ownership, list/date/provider, potential match review, licensed/exempt basis and disposition/reporting evidence.

title: Retention, legal holds and reliable export
applicability: Record class, law, entity role and triggering event determine duration; state and litigation obligations may be longer.
requirement: Apply separate retention schedules for disclosures, compensation, applications, communications and reports; prevent deletion during legal holds.
platformGap: Partial: application history and document cleanup exist; legally configured retention/hold enforcement across databases, objects and backups is unverified.
evidence: Record class, trigger/time, applicable schedule versions, hold/release authority, immutable artifact/export and deletion log.

title: Accessible borrower experience
applicability: ADA obligations for covered businesses and effective communication; Title II public-entity rule is not automatically the private-broker standard.
requirement: Provide usable access and accommodations for application, documents, signing and communication; use a reviewed accessibility standard and human testing.
platformGap: Partial: design/accessibility work is documented, but complete portal/signature/provider accessibility conformance is unverified.
evidence: Keyboard/screen-reader checks, accessible documents, accommodation route, provider testing and resolved barrier reports.
